messages:
Tom - SEO: Quick heads-up — preflight for next Wed's webinar + accompanying benchmark post. Need a prioritized keyword list, schema plan, sitemap entries, and a redirect matrix for legacy blog pages we’ll repurpose.
Maya (Growth): Got it. Do we have target ICP segments to bias keywords? startup vs enterprise?
Tom - SEO: Primary: 'low-latency LLM inference' (startup docs), Secondary: 'inference cost optimization' (enterprise). Also long tails: 'batching for inference', 'kv-cache benefits'.
Elena - Content: Can you drop the canonical targets? Are we consolidating old case-study pages into a single pillar?
Tom - SEO: Yes — consolidate 3 case-study pages -> /benchmarks/inference-cost-performance. Canonical will point to that. Need 301s from old slugs.
Samir - Webdev: I can do 301s. Can you share exact old URLs and desired status? Also need nginx snippet for mass redirects.
Tom - SEO: Old slugs: /bench/case-1, /bench/case-2, /bench/compare-2019 -> all -> /benchmarks/inference-cost-performance
Samir - Webdev: Ok adding to deploy list. nginx redirect snippet:

```
location /bench/ {
  return 301 $scheme://$host/benchmarks/inference-cost-performance$request_uri;
}
```

Samir - Webdev: Will QA for query string preservation.
Maya (Growth): Schema — do we use Article+Event for webinar landing? Also FAQ schema for SEO snippets?
Elena - Content: Yes Article on the post + Event on landing page. FAQs for common how-to and benchmark methodology. I'll draft.
Martech Bot: Reminder: assets deadline in 48h — fill the webinar form: https://forms.redwood.ai/webinar-assets
Tom - SEO: Also internal linking plan: add pillar link in top nav, include 3 CTAs from product docs. I'll post link map in #docs after lunch.
Maya (Growth): Putting keyword priorities into the tracker now. ping me if you want traffic/intent split.
Samir - Webdev: Deploy window Wed 03:00-05:00 UTC. Prefer no other releases then.
Elena - Content: Draft ready for review by EOD tomorrow.
Tom - SEO: Perfect. Final ask — please add redirect test cases to QA checklist (status 301 + canonical present). Thanks :thumbsup:
Maya (Growth): Thanks team — syncing in 30.
